label.english: Leave the existing arrangements in place

description.simp_chinese: 选举协议不会自动决定内阁组成，各党仍须决定是否支持共同执政纲领。

label.simp_chinese: 将选举协议转为执政合作

description.english: The veterans’ movement proposes a legal party organization. The new organization can enter competition without receiving a unique engine ideology slot.
description.simp_chinese: 退伍军人运动提出建立合法政党。新组织无需独占一个原版意识形态槽位，也能参与竞争。

title.english: Labor relations under the New Deal

description.english: Manufacturers and labor federations demand incompatible priorities. Both possess influence independent of their party connections.
description.simp_chinese: 制造商与劳工联合组织提出相互冲突的优先事项，双方都有独立于党派关系的影响力。

description.english: Reform-minded legislators seek a voice in the governing agreement. A broad party label does not erase their distinct priorities.
description.simp_chinese: 改革派议员要求在执政协议内拥有更大话语权，宽泛的党派标签并未消除其独立诉求。

description.english: Military and enterprise institutions seek room to act within the party-state. Concentrating authority may improve control while deepening discontent.
description.simp_chinese: 军方与企业机构寻求在党国体制内扩大行动空间。集权可强化控制，也可能加剧不满。

description.english: A broad rural constituency has little direct influence. The government can exchange concessions for greater institutional acceptance.
description.simp_chinese: 广泛的乡村支持群体缺乏直接影响力，政府可通过让步换取更多制度认同。

description.english: A hereditary institution and a mobilizing party need not prefer the same distribution of authority. The governing agreement requires maintenance.
description.simp_chinese: 世袭机构与动员型政党未必认同同一种权力分配方式，执政协议需要持续维护。

title.simp_chinese: 天主教社团与公共活动

description.english: Religious associations ask to retain autonomous social activity. Their support base overlaps with both monarchists and government supporters.
description.simp_chinese: 宗教社团要求保留自主社会活动，其支持者与君主派和政府支持者存在重叠。

description.english: Competing military factions seek influence over the state. Resolving the dispute changes political power without requiring either faction to become a party.
description.simp_chinese: 竞争性的军事派系寻求影响国家，解决争端会改变政治权力，而无需将任一派系变为政党。

description.english: Court, parties and military institutions disagree on who should participate in the governing agreement.
description.simp_chinese: 宫廷、政党与军事机构对谁应参与执政协议存在分歧。

label.english: Bring army leadership into the agreement
label.simp_chinese: 将陆军领导层纳入协议

description.english: A domestic settlement could grant rival networks legal room without merging their organizations or changing the state’s institutions.
description.simp_chinese: 国内和解可赋予竞争网络合法空间，而不必合并组织或改变国家制度。

description.english: A new civic political current asks for a recognized organization and a place in consultation.
description.simp_chinese: 新的公民政治思潮要求获得组织承认，并参与协商。

label.english: Permit the constitutional movement to organize

description.english: The Popular Front can become a governing agreement, but union and party participants will retain distinct interests.
description.simp_chinese: 人民阵线可以转为执政协议，但工会与政党成员仍将保留各自利益。

label.simp_chinese: 寻求更广泛共和中间派

description.english: The anarcho-syndicalist labor movement rejects absorption into parliamentary organizations. Dialogue may improve satisfaction without requiring coalition membership.
description.simp_chinese: 无政府工团主义劳工运动拒绝被议会组织吸收，对话可在不要求加入联盟的情况下提高满意度。

title.english: A Camp of National Unity begins activity
title.simp_chinese: 民族团结阵营开始活动

description.english: Government supporters propose a new political organization. Its emergence changes the governing compact without inventing a new ideology category.
description.simp_chinese: 政府支持者提出成立新的政治组织，该组织的出现将改变执政协议，而无需创造新的意识形态类别。

label.english: Authorize and support the new camp

description.english: Socialists, peasant representatives and Christian democrats seek greater political participation while preserving separate programs.
description.simp_chinese: 社会主义者、农民代表与基督教民主派在保留各自纲领的同时，寻求扩大政治参与。

description.english: Employers seek a regular hearing for industrial concerns. A standing forum would temporarily increase their access to government.
description.simp_chinese: 雇主要求建立常态渠道反映产业诉求。固定协商机制会暂时提高其接触政府的能力。

description.english: Trade union delegates propose a ninety-day consultation compact. Its immediate reassurance is separate from the institutional access developed over time.
description.simp_chinese: 工会代表提出为期九十日的协商协议。即时的信任改善与逐步形成的制度渠道分别发挥作用。

description.english: The union asks for a standing institutional foothold. The agreement would remain in effect until explicitly withdrawn.
description.simp_chinese: 工会要求获得稳定的制度地位。协议将持续生效，直到被明确撤销。

description.english: Business representatives request regular access to policy discussions. Their influence can change without automatically increasing popular support.
description.simp_chinese: 企业代表要求定期参与政策讨论。制度影响力可以变化，而不必同时增加民众支持。

description.english: Army representatives request an institutional review. The review would gradually change preferences about concentrated authority.
description.simp_chinese: 军方代表要求开展制度审议。审议将逐步改变其对权力集中程度的偏好。

description.english: Religious associations seek a durable network of local activity. They can retain a distinct identity without joining the governing party.
description.simp_chinese: 宗教社团寻求建立持久的地方活动网络，无须加入执政党也能维持独立身份。

description.english: Naval representatives enter a policy review. A temporary diplomatic agreement would affect their preferred approach to external conflict.
description.simp_chinese: 海军代表参加政策审议。临时外交协议会影响其对外部冲突的政策偏好。

description.english: Local associations debate a common charter. Equal membership would temporarily alter their social and national positions.
description.simp_chinese: 地方社团讨论共同章程。平等成员原则会暂时改变其社会结构与民族国家立场。

description.simp_chinese: 工会代表提出两种方案：建立制度协商协议，或订立以公民权利保障为核心的协议。

description.english: The governing circle debates a time-limited commitment to shared authority and a broader institutional compromise.
description.simp_chinese: 执政集团讨论限期共享权力的承诺，以及更广泛的制度妥协。

description.english: Employers, the governing party and the trade unions propose different limits on the institutions coordinating national resources. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商联合会、执政党与工会分别提出全国资源协调机构的权限边界。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Industry representatives and organized labor seek a new agreement, while parliamentary conservatives argue for a single accountable executive. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商代表与有组织的劳工希望达成新协议，议会保守派则主张将责任集中于统一的行政机构。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Manufacturers, the governing party and industrial unions disagree over how a national coordination program should distribute influence. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 制造商、执政党与产业工会对全国协调计划应当如何分配政治影响力存在分歧。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Industrial managers, security officials and cooperative associations put forward competing arrangements for supervision and consultation. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工业管理者、安全机构与合作社团体提出了彼此竞争的监督和协商方案。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Industry, the army and Catholic associations each seek guarantees that a new coordination agreement will not erase their own institutional voice. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商组织、军队与天主教社团都希望新协调协议保障其自身的制度发言权。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Business circles, military organizers and the Social Mass Party disagree on whether social participation should accompany stronger economic coordination. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商界、军方组织者与社会大众党对加强经济协调是否应当同时扩大社会参与意见不一。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Business networks, central officers and rural associations propose rival ways to coordinate resources without dissolving their separate organizations. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商网络、中央军官与乡村社团提出不同的资源协调方案，并希望维持各自组织的独立身份。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Traditionalist networks, military officers and labor representatives contest the future of political participation. Restoring independent labor activity would be an explicit alternative to the later bookmark's restrictions. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 传统主义网络、军官团与劳工代表争论未来的政治参与方式。恢复独立劳工活动将明确改变后期开局中的限制，而非复述历史结果。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

description.english: Industry, military circles and the unions seek a settlement over who receives institutional access and who bears the political cost of coordination. This is an authored alternate-history negotiation; its date is a gameplay opportunity.
description.simp_chinese: 工商界、军方集团与工会尝试就制度参与渠道及协调政策的政治代价达成安排。本事件为架空协商机会，日期仅用于玩法安排。

title.english: Party command or an administrative compact?
title.simp_chinese: 党内指挥还是行政协议？

description.english: A proposed reallocation of executive responsibility has exposed differences between the ruling party, industrial employers and the officer corps. Party officials demand an exclusive mandate; industrial and military representatives seek a binding agreement of their own. An interim administration is also being discussed while the dispute remains unsettled.
description.simp_chinese: 一项重新分配行政职责的提案暴露了执政党、工业界与军官团之间的分歧。党内官员要求取得单独授权，工商与军方代表则希望通过新的共同协议约束行政权。各方也在讨论先由看守行政当局维持日常事务。

label.english: Give the ruling party sole executive responsibility
label.simp_chinese: 由执政党单独承担行政责任

label.english: Conclude a party, industry and officer compact
label.simp_chinese: 签订党、工商界与军官团的共同协定

label.english: Place daily administration under a caretaker
label.simp_chinese: 交由看守行政当局维持日常事务

title.english: The basis of the next ministry
title.simp_chinese: 下一届内阁的政治基础

description.english: Conservative leaders are reviewing the authority of the ministry. One proposal leaves executive responsibility with their own party; another invites Labour and the Liberals to negotiate a broader governing agreement. The Crown could instead appoint a caretaker while the parties continue their discussions.
description.simp_chinese: 保守党领袖正在重新审视内阁的授权。一项提案由本党单独承担执政责任，另一项则邀请工党与自由党谈判更广泛的执政协议。王室也可先任命看守内阁，等待党派协商取得结果。

label.english: Invite Labour and the Liberals into a new agreement
label.simp_chinese: 与工党、自由党达成新的执政协议
协商期间任命看守内阁

title.english: A mandate for the Council of Ministers

description.english: The Radicals are considering whether to accept responsibility alone or negotiate a new support agreement with the Socialists and the Democratic Alliance. The proposal concerns political backing for the ministry rather than a fixed allocation of ministerial portfolios. A caretaker ministry could maintain administration while negotiations continue.
description.simp_chinese: 激进党正在考虑单独承担执政责任，或与工人国际法国支部、民主联盟谈判新的支持协议。这份提案确定的是内阁的政治基础，并不预先分配部长席位。各方也可暂由看守内阁维持行政运转，继续协商。

label.english: Entrust the ministry to the Radicals
label.simp_chinese: 授权激进党单独承担执政责任

label.english: Negotiate a Radical, Socialist and Alliance agreement
label.simp_chinese: 达成激进党、社会党与民主联盟的协议

label.english: Retain a caretaker while talks continue
label.simp_chinese: 继续协商，由看守内阁维持行政

description.english: Democratic leaders face a proposal to distinguish executive responsibility from their agreements in Congress. They may retain a Democratic mandate or negotiate explicit cooperation with progressive and Republican legislators. A temporary caretaker arrangement has also been proposed pending a broader political settlement; none of these proposals dissolves existing labor or electoral associations.
description.simp_chinese: 民主党领袖面临一项重新界定行政责任与国会支持关系的提案。他们可以维持民主党的单独授权，也可与进步派及共和党议员商定明确的合作安排。另有人提议先设立过渡性的看守行政安排，等待政治协商完成。既有劳工与选举合作继续存在。

label.english: Keep executive responsibility with the Democrats
label.simp_chinese: 由民主党单独承担行政责任

label.english: Agree cooperation with progressive and Republican legislators
label.simp_chinese: 与进步派及共和党议员达成合作
采取临时看守行政安排

title.simp_chinese: 党国体制内的行政责任

description.english: Party officials, enterprise directors and union representatives are debating a proposed division of administrative responsibility. The party leadership could retain a sole mandate, or the three institutions could establish a joint administrative compact. A caretaker executive has also been suggested while the leadership settles the terms; this is an institutional dispute within the party-state.
description.simp_chinese: 党内官员、企业管理者与工会代表正在讨论一项行政职责分配提案。党的领导机构可以保留单独授权，也可与另外两类机构建立共同的行政协定。部分代表主张先由看守行政当局维持事务，等待领导层确定安排。这是一场党国体制内部的机构协商。

label.english: Retain the party leadership’s sole mandate
label.simp_chinese: 由党的领导机构保留单独授权
建立党、企业与工会的共同行政协定

label.english: Assign routine administration to a caretaker executive
label.simp_chinese: 由看守行政当局处理日常事务

title.english: The party, the Crown and executive authority

description.english: A proposed executive settlement has reopened negotiations between the ruling party, the royal court and industrial employers. Party representatives seek a mandate of their own, while the court and employers want their commitments written into a joint agreement. A royal caretaker administration could suspend the dispute over governing responsibility while negotiations continue.
description.simp_chinese: 一项新的行政安排提案，使执政党、王室与工业界重新展开协商。党代表要求取得单独授权，宫廷与工商代表则希望把各方承诺写入共同协议。王室也可先任命看守行政当局，暂缓执政责任之争。

label.english: Grant the party a sole executive mandate
label.simp_chinese: 给予执政党单独的行政授权

label.english: Conclude a Crown, party and industry agreement
label.simp_chinese: 签订王室、执政党与工商界的共同协议
请王室任命看守行政当局

title.english: Political backing for a new cabinet

description.english: Senior statesmen are considering an alternative cabinet mandate. Minseito could accept responsibility alone, or negotiate political support with Seiyukai and the court. If no durable terms can be agreed, a caretaker cabinet could preserve ordinary administration while the separate parties and institutions continue their talks.
description.simp_chinese: 重臣正在讨论一种替代性的内阁授权。民政党可以单独承担责任，也可与政友会及宫廷谈判新的政治支持安排。若各方无法确定持久的条件，看守内阁可先维持行政，党派与机构继续分别参与协商。

label.english: Agree support between both parties and the court
label.simp_chinese: 达成两党与宫廷的内阁支持协议

label.english: Appoint a caretaker cabinet for the negotiations
label.simp_chinese: 协商期间任命看守内阁

description.english: The Nationalist leadership is reviewing a proposal for executive responsibility. It may retain a sole party mandate or conclude a new agreement with regional military brokers and chambers of commerce. A caretaker administration is a third proposal, allowing routine government to continue while the terms of political support remain unsettled.
description.simp_chinese: 国民党领导层正在审议行政责任安排。中央可以维持党的单独授权，也可与地方军事网络及商会订立新的共同协议。另一项提案是暂设看守行政当局，在政治支持条件尚未确定时维持日常行政。

label.english: Retain the Nationalist Party’s sole mandate
label.simp_chinese: 由国民党维持单独执政授权

label.english: Conclude an agreement with regional and commercial representatives
label.simp_chinese: 与地方军事代表及商会达成协议

label.english: Place routine administration under a caretaker
label.simp_chinese: 由看守行政当局维持日常事务

title.simp_chinese: 政党授权与传统派保障

description.english: An alternative executive proposal brings the unified party organization, army officers and Traditionalist representatives to the same table. The party could receive a sole mandate, or the three groups could accept a new governing compact. A caretaker administration would defer the allocation of political responsibility while preserving the separate organizations.
description.simp_chinese: 一项替代性的行政提案，把统一政党组织、军官集团与传统派代表带到同一张谈判桌前。政党可以取得单独授权，三个集团也可签订新的共同执政协议。看守行政安排则会暂缓政治责任的分配，保留各组织的独立身份。

label.english: Authorize the unified party organization alone
label.simp_chinese: 授权统一政党组织单独执政

label.english: Conclude a party, officer and Traditionalist compact
label.simp_chinese: 签订政党、军官与传统派执政协定

label.english: Appoint a caretaker until the terms are settled
label.simp_chinese: 待条件确定前任命看守行政当局

title.english: The presidency and the governing circles

description.english: The presidential circle is reviewing its relationship with the military circle and the Camp of National Unity. An alternative mandate could place responsibility with the presidential circle alone or bind the three organizations through a new agreement. A caretaker cabinet remains a possible interim arrangement while those commitments are negotiated.
description.simp_chinese: 总统派正在重新审视与军方集团及民族团结营的关系。一种替代性授权可以由总统派单独承担责任，也可让三个组织通过新的协议约定各自承诺。谈判期间，各方仍可选择由看守内阁暂时处理行政。

label.english: Entrust executive responsibility to the presidential circle
label.simp_chinese: 由总统派单独承担行政责任

label.english: Agree a presidential, military and Unity Camp compact
label.simp_chinese: 达成总统派、军方与民族团结营协定

label.english: Appoint a caretaker during the negotiations
label.simp_chinese: 谈判期间任命看守内阁

description.english: Regular consultations improve acceptance of government and slowly expand the organization's institutional access.
description.simp_chinese: 定期协商提高对政府的认可，并逐步扩展该组织的制度渠道。

description.english: A time-limited recruitment effort creates lasting additions to the organization's public support.
description.simp_chinese: 限期招募活动逐步增加组织的民众支持，活动结束后保留已获得的支持。

description.english: Formal access to consultations temporarily strengthens business organizations' institutional influence.
description.simp_chinese: 正式协商渠道暂时提高工商组织的制度影响力。

description.english: An explicit agreement temporarily raises confidence without changing the group's underlying political preferences.
description.simp_chinese: 明确的协议暂时提高信任，不改变组织原有政治倾向。

description.english: Internal review slowly shifts the group toward shared authority while opening a temporary margin for civil guarantees.
description.simp_chinese: 内部审议逐步推动权力共享，并暂时扩大对公民保障的接受空间。

description.english: Public cooperation temporarily improves visibility and encourages a more reform-minded cultural stance.
description.simp_chinese: 公共合作暂时提高组织的社会可见度，并使其文化取向更倾向改革。

description.english: A temporary policy agreement shifts the organization's economic position toward collective provision.
description.simp_chinese: 临时政策协议使组织的经济立场向共同供给方向移动。

description.english: The charter temporarily favors social equality and civic inclusion.
description.simp_chinese: 宪章暂时推动社会平等与公民共同体认同。

description.english: An accommodation gives religious institutions a temporary place in the group's preferred public arrangements.
description.simp_chinese: 协商安排暂时提高宗教机构在组织所主张公共制度中的地位。

description.english: Consultations temporarily move the organization toward restraint in external conflict.
description.simp_chinese: 协商暂时推动组织在对外冲突中采取克制立场。

description.english: Public guarantees temporarily raise acceptance of civil liberties.
description.simp_chinese: 公共保障暂时提高对公民自由的认可。

description.english: An agreement temporarily moderates preferences about the head of state and disperses political authority.
description.simp_chinese: 协议暂时缓和国家元首形式上的立场，并推动政治权力分散。

description.english: A standing network increases public reach and institutional access until its agreement is explicitly withdrawn.
description.simp_chinese: 常设网络提高社会覆盖与制度渠道，直到相关协议被明确撤销。

description.english: A breakdown temporarily depresses acceptance while accumulated organizational losses remain after talks resume.
description.simp_chinese: 谈判破裂暂时降低认可度；协商恢复后，期间已经发生的组织损失仍然存在。

description.english: A time-limited pledge supports more distributed authority and improves confidence in the government.
description.simp_chinese: 限期承诺推动权力分散，并提高对政府的信任。

description.english: The charter provides a persistent institutional foothold without obliging the group to join government.
description.simp_chinese: 章程提供持续的制度立足点，不要求该组织加入执政联盟。

description.english: A 180-day agreement grants institutional access and builds public support through continuing consultation.
description.simp_chinese: 为期180天的协定提供制度参与渠道，并通过持续协商积累社会支持。

description.english: A 120-day mandate expands the designated organization's influence while shifting its current policy toward concentrated authority.
description.simp_chinese: 120天的授权扩大指定组织的影响力，使其当前政策偏向集中权力。

description.english: A permanent charter protects an organization's institutional voice without making it a government member.
description.simp_chinese: 常设章程保障组织的制度发言权，不强制其加入执政联盟。

description.english: Exclusion temporarily reduces institutional access and gradually lowers acceptance of the government over 90 days.
description.simp_chinese: 被排除的组织暂时失去部分制度参与渠道，对政府的认可将在90天内逐步下降。

description.english: A ninety-day mandate strengthens one organization’s executive influence without requiring an alliance.
description.simp_chinese: 为期90天的单独授权提高该组织的行政影响力，不要求成立执政联盟。

description.english: A 120-day agreement grants its signatories additional influence and confidence while distributing authority.
description.simp_chinese: 为期120天的协议提高签署组织的影响力与满意度，使其当前权力主张偏向共同承担责任。

description.english: Sixty days of transitional assurances improve confidence and limit discretionary authority without granting a governing mandate.
description.simp_chinese: 为期60天的过渡保障提高满意度并限制自由裁量权，但不授予任何组织执政资格。
